info.title: Online_presence
info.description: Unified OpenAPI specification for online_presence domain

get.description: Returns paginated conversations for the authenticated business. Available for **Staff tokens**

parameters.name: include_simulated
parameters.description: When true, includes conversations created by AI Receptionist simulation and training flows. Simulated conversations are excluded by default.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort expression in `field:asc|desc` format. Allowed fields: `ended_at`, `started_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Default sort is `ended_at:desc`.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Filter conversations ending on or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: Filter conversations ending on or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

parameters.name: client_uid
parameters.description: Filter conversations linked to this CRM contact (client) uid (e.g., "5f8a1b2c3d4e5f60").

parameters.name: matter_uid
parameters.description: Filter conversations linked to this matter uid (e.g., "a1b2c3d4e5f60718").

200.description: List result (`{ success: true, data: { conversations, total } }`)

success.description: Indicates whether the API request was successful (true) or failed (false).

data.description: The response payload. Present on successful responses (success: true).

error.description: Error message for simple error responses. Used in some legacy endpoints.

errors.description: Array of error objects for detailed error responses. Present on error responses (success: false).

field.description: The field that caused the error (for validation errors).

allOf.description: Generic wrapper object for API responses. Success responses contain 'data', while error responses contain 'errors' array or 'error' string.

errors.message: sort field must be one of: ended_at, started_at, created_at, updated_at

success.description: Indicates whether the API request was successful (true) or failed (false).

data.description: The response payload. Present on successful responses (success: true).

error.description: Error message for simple error responses. Used in some legacy endpoints.

errors.description: Array of error objects for detailed error responses. Present on error responses (success: false).

field.description: The field that caused the error (for validation errors).

allOf.description: Generic wrapper object for API responses. Success responses contain 'data', while error responses contain 'errors' array or 'error' string.

data.description: Persisted website AI Receptionist conversation resource. Returned inside `{ data }` for Staff-scoped list/get/create/update APIs (`/v3/online_presence/ai_receptionist_conversations`). Date-time fields use ISO 8601 format. Soft-deleted conversations are not returned in normal API responses.

session_id.description: Chat session id from the online_presence chat service.

transcript.description: Conversation transcript. New records use a structured transcript object (`schemaVersion` + `messages`). Older records may still contain legacy plain text; new integrations should use the structured format.

oneOf.description: Structured transcript object captured when a session ends. Uses the same visitor-visible message list shape that is returned when resuming an active chat session. Consumers should render from `messages` and may derive plain text if needed.

items.description: Visitor-visible chat line (**user** or **assistant**). Used in chat resume responses and stored inside the transcript document for persisted conversations. System prompts and internal tool rows are not included.

message_type.description: Optional semantic marker for assistant status lines emitted while backend tools run (e.g., "Storing your information..."). UI can use this to avoid treating the row as a normal assistant reply.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the server recorded the turn. May be omitted on older Redis session blobs; clients may use it for ordering or display outside the embeddable widget.

example.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

ai_receptionist_training_feedback_histor.description: Append-only AI receptionist training feedback history captured from chat history UI. Each entry stores who submitted the feedback, when it was submitted, scope (`conversation` or `message`), and optional message reference metadata for message-level feedback.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the feedback entry was created.

created_by_staff_uid.description: Staff UID that submitted the feedback.

feedback_scope.description: Feedback scope: entire conversation (`conversation`) or specific assistant message (`message`).

message_reference.description: Optional message reference details for `message` scope feedback.

snippet.description: Short first-words snippet of the referenced message.

role.description: Optional role hint from the UI message id.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help?
I need to book an appointment.

ai_receptionist_training_feedback_histor.feedback_text: Avoid asking for phone again once it was already provided.

message_reference.snippet: Thank you, Itzik. Could you please provide your phone number...

page_url.description: Page URL where the chat started.

client_uid.description: Optional CRM client UID linked to this conversation.

message_count.description: Number of messages in the conversation.

lead_intent.description: Resolved lead intent extracted at conversation close (e.g., "General inquiry"). When no lead data is captured, value may be "N/A".

lead_information.description: Extracted lead key/value pairs captured from the conversation (JSON object, e.g. {"Name":"John Doe","Phone":"+15551234567"}).

source_app_uid.description: Application that delivered the inbound traffic for this conversation. Web widget sessions use null; voice AI Receptionist sessions use "voicecalls".

channel_uid.description: Channel identifier used for attribution in AI Receptionist reporting, such as "voicecalls:setting_123" for a voicecalls phone-number setting.

delivery_kind.description: Lifecycle owner for the conversation. **webaiwidgetmgr** means the website widget owned the session lifecycle, **comm_gw** means Communication Gateway owned lifecycle and release handling, and **voicecalls** means the voicecalls service owned PSTN lifecycle handling.

voice_call_uid.description: Internal voicecalls call UID used to correlate AI Receptionist voice metadata and recording callbacks.

external_uuid.description: External provider conversation UUID, usually the Vonage conversation UUID used by voicecalls webhooks.

voice_metadata.description: Voice-specific metadata for AI Receptionist calls, including caller/callee numbers and recording details when available.

from_number.description: Caller phone number in E.164 format.

to_number.description: Dialed voicecalls phone number in E.164 format.

recording_url.description: Signed call recording URL generated by voicecalls.

recording_received_at.description: Time when webaiwidgetserver received the recording callback.

messages.content: Hi, I need a quote for plumbing work.
Sure. Could you share your name and phone number?

ai_receptionist_training_feedback_histor.feedback_text: Please use a friendlier tone in follow-up messages.

example.summary: Visitor asked for plumbing quote and shared contact details.

data.description: AI Receptionist Configuration for a business: controls how the AI receptionist behaves across all channels (web widget, WhatsApp, etc.). Includes FAQ/guidance, lead capture settings, business hours, knowledge inclusion flags, and proactive action offers. Returned inside `data` (wrapped by standard Response) for authenticated CRUD/main APIs.

owner_uid.description: Staff UID of the last editor.

config.description: The AI chat configuration blob. Sparse — omitted keys use product defaults.

faq_and_guidance.description: Free-text FAQ and guidance instructions for the AI receptionist.

business_hours.description: Business hours text; null uses calendar-derived defaults.

lead_basic_contact_fields.description: Contact info the AI receptionist must try to collect before creating a lead. Guidance only; the CRM still creates a lead whenever a name and at least one of phone/email are present. Null uses the default (e.g., "phone_or_email").

lead_fields.description: Additional lead fields the AI receptionist should try to collect (optional, never blocking).

instructions.description: When/why to ask for this field (e.g., "Only ask if the customer is requesting a home visit.").

include_contact_info.description: Whether to include business contact info in AI guidance context.

include_services.description: Whether to include business services in AI guidance context.

include_products.description: Whether to include business products in AI guidance context.

include_booking_policies.description: Whether to include booking policies in AI guidance context.

include_terms_of_service.description: Whether to include terms of service in AI guidance context.

guidance_urls.description: Extra URLs whose content is merged into AI guidance.

ai_actions.description: AI proactive action behavior. Defines which actions the AI should proactively offer and when.

should_offer.description: Whether the AI should proactively suggest this action.

when_to_offer.description: Guidance text for when the AI should suggest this action (e.g., "Offer when client asks about scheduling").

config.faq_and_guidance: Answer questions about pricing, emergency calls, and availability.

lead_fields.label: Address
lead_fields.instructions: Only ask if the customer is requesting a home visit.

ai_actions.when_to_offer: Offer when client asks about scheduling or availability.

errors.message: AI chat configuration not found for this business

ai_receptionist_training_feedback_histor.description: Append-only AI receptionist training feedback history captured from chat history UI. created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the feedback entry was created.

message_reference.description: Optional message reference details for `message` scope feedback.

snippet.description: Short first-words snippet of the referenced message.

role.description: Optional role hint from the UI message id.
